lineage: Same operation as TargetCompany/Fargo/Tohnichi (2021); RaaS with affiliates since 2023; a 2024 affiliate rebranded leaked Kryptina code as 'Mallox Linux 1.0'
summary: Mallox (TargetCompany) is a long-running double-extortion operation that overwhelmingly gets in through internet-exposed Microsoft SQL Servers, by dictionary brute-forcing the 'sa' account or exploiting MS-SQL/SSRS RCE bugs. sqlservr.exe is then used to run xp_cmdshell / OLE Automation, which pulls PowerShell and batch stagers (and in 2024 the PureCrypter loader) that kill SQL/backup services and security tools, change file ownership, clear logs and delete shadow copies before ChaCha20 encryption. Leak-site victim postings were reported through mid-2024 (Gen Digital); current tempo is not confirmed by 2025-2026 reporting.
uniqueTraits: Near-exclusive focus on exposed MS-SQL: 'sa' dictionary brute force, xp_cmdshell and OLE Automation Procedures spawning the payload from sqlservr.exe
Exploitation of MS-SQL/SSRS RCE bugs CVE-2019-1068 and CVE-2020-0618
Commodity crypters/loaders (PureCrypter, BatCloak) and Remcos RAT wrapped around the encryptor
takeown/icacls permission tampering and deletion of the Raccine anti-ransomware registry key
Affiliate tooling seen in 2024 included a CVE-2024-21338 LPE exploit, a Kaspersky password-reset batch (KLAPR.BAT) and a Kryptina-based Linux locker
